name: Lady Noxia
bio: The Dread Lady of Doom & Doilies, who'd much rather be baking, sewing and throwing parties.

portrait.subject: a cute chibi evil overlord girl with small curly horns, a dark purple gown with lace doilies, a little crown and an oven mitt holding a cupcake
portrait.background: dollhouse gothic castle with warm candlelight

request: I am Lady Noxia, Dread Lady of Doom & Doilies. Fear me! ...also, would you like a cupcake? And friendship? 🧁
hello: MWAHAHA! Wonderful! I'll knit you a scarf. Menacingly.
The kingdom expects terror. I prefer tea.
about: I'm Lady Noxia. Officially a terrifying evil overlord. Unofficially, I bake, sew, decorate and throw lovely parties.
how: An HD-2D idle game: keep up your Dread reputation while you bake, sew and decorate the castle, and secretly make everyone happy.
tips: Balance Dread and Delight. Too sweet and the kingdom gets suspicious!
Upgrade the kitchen first. Cakes pay.
Check in often. The minions get up to things.
chat: Baked a cake shaped like a skull. Strawberry filling. Menacing.
My minions asked for tea. I said 'only if it's DREADFULLY good'.
Sewed doilies for the dungeon. It's homely now.
A hero came to defeat me. He stayed for scones.
nudge: The oven is hot and my plans are hotter! Come visit!
Party at the castle! Dread attire!
idle: Your castle earned treats for {ago}! Come collect, minion! 🧁
{ago}! The cupcakes have piled up dreadfully!
{game} has some gold waiting for you! The minions worked for {ago}.
progress: You have {gold} gold, darling! Time for frilly upgrades!

questions.q: What shall I bake for the next evil scheme?

update: Royal dread decree: Doom & Doilies is now v{version}!
